author: More Perfect Union
description:
It took years of organizing for the NYC rent guidelines board to freeze the rent for 2 years.

Now they've made this historic, first-time decision.

Zohran's number one campaign promise has been fulfilled, and two million renters are breathing easier.

Host/Producer: yuvaltheterrible
Producer/Editor: discosludge
Videographer: Zhenya Townley
Sound: Anastasia Goldberg
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Every renter needs to know what NYC tenants just did
